description: IRVE statique (organisation Recharge Active Solutions) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Recharge Active Solutions. Ce jeu de données présente les informations statiques relatives aux infrastructures de recharge pour véhicules électriques déclarées par Recharge Active Solutions. Il est publié dans le cadre d’un dossier Advenir et permet de référencer les points de recharge conformément au schéma national IRVE statique. Le fichier principal est un fichier CSV au format IRVE statique. Coverage: Recharge Active Solutions. The publisher named on the listing is Recharge Active Solutions. Its keywords include fichier-irve-de-bornes-de-recharge, irve-stations-de-recharge, irve. The listing shows 2 download or service links in PDF, CSV. The listing shows 2026-06-22 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
